description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BaseJSONStorageProvider' for JSON-based storage providers in an Orleans grain storage system. It includes methods for reading, writing, and clearing grain state, handling JSON serialization/deserialization, and managing an external data manager.

classes.name: BaseJSONStorageProvider
classes.description: An abstract class providing JSON serialization-based persistence for Orleans grains, implementing the IGrainStorage interface.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the storage provider by disposing the data manager.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Reads the grain state from storage, deserializes the JSON data, and populates the grain state.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Serializes the grain state into JSON and writes it to storage.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync
methods.description: Deletes the grain state from storage.

methods.name: ConvertToStorageFormat
methods.description: Serializes grain state to JSON string.

methods.name: ConvertFromStorageFormat
methods.description: Deserializes JSON string into grain state.
